subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested `streaming.preview` policy for `toolProgress` and `commandText`, and should the agent-facing gateway continue to reject direct patches to `channels.feishu.streaming`?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix changes Feishu's public config shape and touches the model-to-operator config mutation boundary, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Preserve current boolean/default behavior while adding Feishu support for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, with focused schema, manifest, docs, and dispatcher tests.

options.title: Only soften command wording
options.body: Keep Feishu streaming config boolean-only and separately improve benign non-zero command-output wording, which reduces scary copy but still leaves no Feishu streaming-without-progress mode.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Permit agent-facing `config.patch` to toggle `channels.feishu.streaming`, which helps recovery but broadens an operator-controlled path and does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Preserve current boolean/default behavior while adding Feishu support for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, with focused schema, manifest, docs, and dispatcher tests.

likelyOwner.reason: CONTRIBUTING.md routes Chinese channels including Feishu to this person, making them the best available product-direction owner among the inspected routing signals.
